status: PRE-REGISTERED before any training. Frozen. Applied mechanically by select_candidate.py; NO manual override.
step_1_eligibility: Keep only Stage A arms that satisfy EVERY criterion in ACCEPTANCE_GATES.json:stage_a_arm_eligibility (e1..e8). B0 is a control and is NOT eligible for selection.

step_2_rank_eligible_arms_by.k1: highest number of diagnostic seeds formed (of 3)

step_2_rank_eligible_arms_by.k2: highest count of rescued historical non-formers (seed 3 and/or seed 7)

step_2_rank_eligible_arms_by.k3: highest MINIMUM per-seed (S - A+) d96 margin across the 3 diagnostic seeds

step_2_rank_eligible_arms_by.k4: highest MEDIAN (S - A+) d96 margin across the 3 diagnostic seeds

step_2_rank_eligible_arms_by.k6: simplest intervention by the fixed simplicity order below

simplicity_note: O1/O2 are ranked as the simplest family (single optimizer schedule change). Within O1 vs O2, apply k1..k5 first; only if still tied use this order (O1 before O2).
step_3_tie_break: If two eligible arms tie through k1..k6 (including simplicity), select the LEXICOGRAPHICALLY FIRST arm ID and document the tie in the selection trace.
step_4_no_candidate: If NO Stage A arm is eligible, do NOT run Stage B and classify NO_STABILIZATION_CANDIDATE.
step_5_single_candidate: Select AT MOST ONE primary intervention candidate. Freeze its full config + hashes into SELECTED_CANDIDATE.json, commit and push BEFORE any fresh Stage B training, then re-run verify_preregistration.py.
combination_prohibition: This phase selects exactly one arm. It does NOT combine the optimizer winner with K1, and does NOT combine Family 1 or Family 2 with the scaffold winner. Combinations are a later phase, only after individual effects are known.
